caption: The drawing depicts a piece of furniture composed of a dark wooden lower chest with four large drawers, each fitted with two brass-colored handles. Sitting on top of the chest is an upper cabinet with glass-paneled doors and sides; the glass features a diamond lattice pattern, bordered by the same dark wood. The upper section is crowned with a decorative structure, including three pointed arches projecting upwards, each topped with a finial or ornamental knob. The top of the cabinet and the edges of the glass panels are highlighted with thin dark lines, emphasizing their shape. The wood of the entire structure is a reddish-brown, while the glass panels are tinted with subtle shades of pink, blue, yellow, and green, reflecting light and giving a multicolored effect. The background is a plain, light beige, with faint shadows cast on the wall and floor, and some soft colored areas suggesting reflected light or painted marks near the base. There are no other objects or visible details apart from the furniture and its cast shadow.
title: Secretary
